What We Do

Three jobs. Done right, done fast.

Every job starts with a free estimate. No prices guessed over the phone sight-unseen, no pressure — you see the number before any saw starts.

01

Emergency Tree Removal

Storm-downed, split, uprooted, or leaning trees — including trees on roofs, cars, fences, and power-line-adjacent hazards. The crew secures the scene, rigs and sections the tree down safely, and hauls the debris away.

  • Emergency response
  • Tree on structure
  • Storm cleanup
  • Full debris haul-away
02

Trimming & Pruning

The fix before it becomes an emergency. Deadwood removal, crown lifting off roofs and sidewalks, clearance from wires and structures, and shaping that keeps healthy trees standing through the next storm season.

  • Deadwood & hazard limbs
  • Roof & wire clearance
  • Crown shaping
  • Storm-season prep
03

Stump Grinding

The trip hazard in the yard, the stump the mower hates, the eyesore by the stoop — ground below soil level so you can replant, reseed, or pave over it. Bundle it with a removal and it's handled in the same visit.

  • Ground below grade
  • Same-visit with removal
  • Replant-ready finish
  • Yard reclaimed
When You Call

From “tree down” to cleaned up

Emergencies feel chaotic. The response shouldn't be. Here's exactly what happens after you reach out.

1

Call or text the details

One call to (888) 217-8781 — or send the quote-builder summary with photos. You describe what's down, what's under it, and where. That photo is worth a thousand words to a crew chief.

2

Get your free estimate

A straight, free estimate for the work — removal, trimming, or grinding — before anything starts. You approve the number, or you don't. No obligation either way.

3

Made safe, hauled away

The crew rigs, cuts, and lowers the tree in controlled sections, protects your roof, siding, and yard, then hauls the debris out — driveway open, property clear.

If a tree is on your roof right now: stay out of the room beneath it, keep people and pets clear of the lean, don't climb up for a closer look, and if wires are involved, treat them as live. Then call (888) 217-8781 — that's the whole to-do list.

Straight Answers

Before you call

Is the estimate really free?+

Yes — estimates are free. Call or send the quote-builder summary with photos, and you'll get a number for the work before anything starts. If you don't like the number, that's the end of it. No obligation, no pressure.

A tree just fell on my house. What do I do first?+

Keep everyone out of the rooms under the tree and away from the lean side. Don't go on the roof, and treat any downed wires as live. Then call (888) 217-8781 — the emergency line is answered for emergencies, and a photo sent by text helps the crew arrive with the right rigging.

Can the stump be ground the same visit?+

In most removals, yes — mention the stump when you call or in the quote builder and it can be bundled into the same visit and the same free estimate, ground below grade so the spot is replant-ready.

Do you haul away the wood and debris?+

Yes — removal includes taking the sections, limbs, and debris away so your driveway, sidewalk, and yard are clear when the crew leaves. If you'd rather keep firewood, say so on the call and they'll stack it instead.

My tree hasn't fallen — it just looks dangerous. Worth a call?+

That's the best time to call. A cracked or hanging limb over a roof, car, or sidewalk is a hazardous-limb job, and trimming it now is simpler and cheaper than an emergency removal after the next storm. The estimate is free either way.

Which areas do you cover?+

All of Queens — based in Corona (108-69 39th Ave), regularly working Jamaica, Flushing, Jackson Heights, Elmhurst, Forest Hills, Astoria, and the rest of the borough.
